Human-Computer Interaction Design: Autumn 2026 - Syllabus
Meeting Times and Location: Wednesday, periods: 2-4, 
Credit Hours: 3.0
Instructors: Ryan Sheng-Ming Wang

Course Description: 
"Human-Computer Interaction Design" blends theoretical and practical perspectives in visualization and interactivity into several focused aspects using interactivity for education, entertainment, interactive media design, and industrial design purposes. 
An interface is a link between a user and a design that communicates how a design will be used, creating an experience for the people who will use it. It provides the framework, elements, and resources for a “conversation” between users and design.
This course will explore the fundamentals of interfaces and the human-computer interaction design process. Students will be introduced to and able to practice the fundamental concepts, methods, and human-computer interaction design practices. They will explore the ideas of "User Experience Observation ", "Form Follows Function," and "User Interaction Analysis and Evaluation". They will explore how interactive media create experiences and understand the role that interaction with content and installation fulfills in human existence. Finally and most importantly, students need to learn how to improve their ability to present their design ideas.
This class is devoted to lectures, discussions, practice activities, design work sessions, and critiques of practical work. 


Course Objectives/Goals: 
At the conclusion of the course, students will be able to: 
1.	Identify how increasingly complex technologies are integrated into designs, services and events. 
2.	Define how digital or physical artifacts behave in response to user-centric interaction. 
3.	Describe, test and evaluate the usability and sustainability of user interfaces. 
4.	Apply iterative cycles of research, testing, and development based on the understanding of user needs, goals, and experiences. 
5.	Develop solutions and processes to common or known interface problems. 
6.	Build and test rapid prototypes for look and feel and usability. 
7.	Utilize client-based concept development to develop the strategy, information architecture, human-computer interaction, and interface design. 
8.	Demonstrate competency in information architecture, human-computer interaction, and interface design.
課程進度(1-16週):
This course is focused on introducing the knowledge of human-computer interaction (HCI) design and accompanying design practice. This will allow students to understand the process of user interface design and related applications so as to be capable of practical interface design. The contents include conceptual model, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design, and user testing. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case study, and practical work and evaluated by students' reports, oral presentations and design work

彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 參與校內外活動 (講座、工作坊、參訪) 或競賽 (Participation in on-campus or off-campus activities (lectures, workshops, visits) or competitions)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          17 至 18 週彈性學習的時間將提前安排學生參加「台灣設計週」的展覽活動，並設定「設計週裡的 HCI and UI/UX：互動體驗考察與跨領域再設計」。主要目的是將理論落地為實務觀察的極佳切入點。由於 HCI 兼具「設計思維」與「技術落實」，兩週彈性時間的規劃應採「展前問題導向準備  、現場考察檢驗，展後實作再設計提案」的反轉課堂架構。
課程學習目標： 訓練學生以 HCI 專家角色的觀察力，並具備將展覽亮點轉化為技術 prototype 的實作能力。
課程規劃如下：
階段一：展前準備與導覽框架設定 (課堂線上/實體 3 小時)。 聚焦於 HCI x UI/UX 評估框架。並安排學生每組 3-4 人進行主題分組與任務派發
階段二：自主/團體展場參訪實察：時間 (展場實地考察 6 小時作為彈性學習)。 學生至桃園青埔會展中心展區進行考察。並紀錄展件的互動流程及觀察一般民眾在使用該互動展件時的真實反應與痛點，並做問卷調查。
階段三：展後成果工作坊與技術提案 (課堂實體 3 小時)。各組 HCI 痛點分析報告，每組 8 分鐘 Rapid Pitch，分享參訪發現的最佳/最差 HCI
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          學生需以「跨領域 HCI x UI/UX/設計師」的角度，交付以下三項整合成果：  
1. 「HCI 展場體驗診斷報告」 (PDF/Slide) ： 選出 1 個「優良互動展件」與 1 個「失敗/待改進互動展件」。
2. 技術與體驗拆解： 分析其使用的感測技術與 UI/UX 設計邏輯。
3. 使用者行為觀察紀錄： 附上記錄影片與使用者痛點分析表。並針對該「待改進展件」，提出改善後的 HCI x UI/UX 替代方案。
4. HCI x UI/UX 技術與使用這經驗評估報告撰寫：透過 HCI (人機互動) 理論、UI/UX 技術 與 使用者經驗 (UX) 評估報告 整合導入課程或實務專案，關鍵在於讓學生/團隊不只停留於「視覺美感」或「觀展感想」，而是能運用科學化、可量化的 HCI 評估架構來進行設計診斷與報告撰寫。 
5. 「3 分鐘 Demonstration Video」：錄製短影音，呈現「展覽現場真實痛點  、並提出的 HCI x UI/UX 技術/設計改善方案  、概念驗證影片」
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          參訪與實作單元將占全學期總成績 20%。評量注重「理論連結」、「現場觀察深度」與「HCI 技術改善可行性」。
1. 展前準備與觀察量表設計 (15%) ：能否正確運用 HCI 理論（如 Affordance、Feedback、Accessibility）編寫出具體且可執行的展場考察清單。
2. 展場診斷與深度分析報告 (35%) ：能否精準拆解展件的「技術架構」與「使用者體驗問題」，並有實地觀察影像/數據支持，而非僅寫觀展心得。
3. HCI x UI/UX 重構實作與原型展現 (35%) ：提出的 Redesign 方案是否具備技術可行性？Prototype 能否有效解決現場觀察到的痛點？
4. 同儕互評與現場簡報 (15%) ：展後工作坊的簡報流暢度、回答問題能力，以及對其他組別 HCI x UI/UX 方案提出的建構性回饋。
